CONTINUING LETTER OF GUARANTEE

Riverbend Ingredients, LLC (“Guarantor”) hereby guarantees to Medosweet Farms, Inc. (“Buyer”) that all food ingredients sold or delivered to Buyer are not, at the time of shipment, adulterated or misbranded within the meaning of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, and are not articles which may not be introduced into interstate commerce under Sections 404 or 505 of that Act.

Guarantor further warrants that the goods are produced under a written food safety plan compliant with 21 CFR Part 117, that all ingredients are sourced from approved suppliers subject to a documented Foreign Supplier Verification Program where applicable, and that no product supplied is knowingly derived from a facility under an active FDA import alert.

This guarantee applies to the products listed below and remains continuing and in effect for all shipments until revoked by Guarantor in writing. It supersedes the letter of guarantee dated January 4, 2024.
